title: A course pack's match puzzle (courses/<id>/puzzles/<name>.json)
description: Match each one (a crew) to the place that fits its order. `places` come in key order; each order lists every right place (`accept`, `best` among them) and what the others say (`why`). A puzzle the course runs has its mechanic's fields; a `"disabled": true` file needs none. Every puzzle file has an `id`, its `mechanic`, and may set `disabled` (the site stays as scenery), `text` (its words by key, `{name}` filled in by the game) and `lines` (its voice line ids by what they're for). docs/specs/COURSE-PACKS.md §4.

quest.description: The quest the puzzle plays in (a quest of this course): the steps its mechanic sets and waits on (PUZZLE_STEPS, src/course/puzzles.ts) are that quest's.

steps.description: The mechanic's steps (PUZZLE_STEPS) that the quest calls something else: game step → the quest's step.

disabled.description: The course turns this puzzle off: its site stays as scenery and its cue does nothing.

text.description: The puzzle's words by key (labels, hints, readouts, signs).

lines.description: Voice line ids (voice/lines.json) by what they're for.

places.description: The course's places, each bound to what the game does with the crew's water (channel: its own channel to its wheel; hall: through the Great Hall; gondola: off the deck), each once. Orders name places by the course's ids.
